integrity: The proof is symbolic except for an exhaustive finite factorization of fifteen explicit integers \(K_E\le39\), independently regenerated by the included verifier.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to squarefree integers of the form \(2pq\) with odd primes \(p<q\); no claim is made for nonsquarefree or higher-support cases.
title: Exactly \(4\)-deficient-perfect numbers of the form \(2pq\)
